title: Read only a valid title
prompt: Write `safeTitle(value: unknown): string | null`. When `value` is an object (not `null`, not an array) whose `title` is a string, return that title, even an empty one. For any other value, return `null`.
hints: Try `{ title: 4 }`. What does the starter return?
Check that `value` is a plain object before reading `title`.
Check `typeof value.title === "string"`. Do not test truthiness, or `""` is lost.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Uses `as`, which changes nothing at runtime, so a numeric title gets through.
Drops an empty title because `""` is falsy.

feedback: Try `{ title: 4 }`. What does the starter return?
